name: HDFS 3080
title: Seminar Internship
description: Through a weekly seminar, this course provides supervision for students interning in community organizations that support the development and welfare of individuals and families. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: GPA of 2.5 in HDFS courses and at least 15 credits of 2000 level or above HDFS courses. May not be taken out of sequence after passing HDFS 3090.
